# Sample size calculation for proportion confidence interval
# Using normal approximation with exact standard normal quantile

# Parameters
p <- 0.70  # target proportion
z_alpha_2 <- 1.959964  # exact standard normal 97.5th percentile (two-sided alpha=0.05)
ME <- 0.03  # margin of error (half-width)

# Formula: n = z^2 * p(1-p) / ME^2
n_continuous <- (z_alpha_2^2 * p * (1 - p)) / (ME^2)

# Round upward to nearest integer
n_rounded <- ceiling(n_continuous)

cat("Proportion confidence interval sample size calculation\n")
cat("=====================================================\n")
cat(sprintf("Target proportion (p): %.2f\n", p))
cat(sprintf("Standard normal 97.5th percentile (z): %.6f\n", z_alpha_2))
cat(sprintf("Margin of error / half-width (ME): %.2f\n", ME))
cat(sprintf("\nFormula: n = z² × p(1-p) / ME²\n"))
cat(sprintf("Continuous solution: n = (%.6f)² × %.2f × %.2f / (%.2f)²\n", 
            z_alpha_2, p, 1-p, ME))
cat(sprintf("Continuous solution: n = %.4f\n", n_continuous))
cat(sprintf("\nRounded upward: n = %d participants\n", n_rounded))

# Verify: check the actual half-width achieved with n_rounded
half_width_achieved <- z_alpha_2 * sqrt(p * (1 - p) / n_rounded)
cat(sprintf("\nVerification:\n")
cat(sprintf("Half-width achieved with n=%d: %.6f\n", n_rounded, half_width_achieved))
cat(sprintf("Meets requirement (≤ %.2f)? %s\n", ME, 
            if (half_width_achieved <= ME) "YES" else "NO"))

# Store results for output
results <- data.frame(
  metric = "sample_size",
  value = n_rounded,
  unit = "participants_total"
)

# Output JSON for POWER_AGENT_RESULT
library(jsonlite)
output_list <- list(
  results = list(
    list(metric = "sample_size", value = n_rounded, unit = "participants_total")
  )
)

cat("\n")
cat(toJSON(output_list, auto_unbox = TRUE, digits = 15))

# Independent verification using alternative implementation
# Proportion confidence interval sample size calculation

# Specified parameters from the original request
p <- 0.70              # target proportion
conf_level <- 0.95     # confidence level (two-sided)
half_width <- 0.03     # desired half-width (margin of error)
z_critical <- 1.959964 # exact standard normal 97.5th percentile

# Manual calculation of sample size using the formula:
# n = z^2 * p(1-p) / ME^2

z_squared <- z_critical^2
p_times_q <- p * (1 - p)
me_squared <- half_width^2

n_continuous <- z_squared * p_times_q / me_squared

# Round upward
n_final <- ceiling(n_continuous)

cat("Independent Verification of Proportion Confidence Interval Sample Size\n")
cat("=====================================================================\n\n")
cat("Parameters:\n")
cat(sprintf("  Target proportion (p): %g\n", p))
cat(sprintf("  Confidence level: %g (two-sided)\n", conf_level))
cat(sprintf("  Desired half-width: %g\n", half_width))
cat(sprintf("  Standard normal 97.5th percentile: %g\n", z_critical))
cat("\nCalculation:\n")
cat(sprintf("  z² = (%.6f)² = %.10f\n", z_critical, z_squared))
cat(sprintf("  p(1-p) = %.2f × %.2f = %.2f\n", p, 1-p, p_times_q))
cat(sprintf("  ME² = (%.2f)² = %.4f\n", half_width, me_squared))
cat(sprintf("  n = %.10f × %.2f / %.4f = %.4f\n", z_squared, p_times_q, me_squared, n_continuous))
cat(sprintf("  n (rounded up) = %d\n\n", n_final))

# Verification: compute achieved half-width with n_final
achieved_se <- sqrt(p * (1 - p) / n_final)
achieved_hw <- z_critical * achieved_se

cat("Verification:\n")
cat(sprintf("  Standard error with n=%d: %.8f\n", n_final, achieved_se))
cat(sprintf("  Half-width achieved: z × SE = %.6f × %.8f = %.8f\n", 
            z_critical, achieved_se, achieved_hw))
cat(sprintf("  Target half-width: %.2f\n", half_width))
cat(sprintf("  Achieved ≤ Target? %s\n\n", if(achieved_hw <= half_width) "YES" else "NO"))

# Also check n-1 to confirm this is the minimum
achieved_hw_n_minus_1 <- z_critical * sqrt(p * (1 - p) / (n_final - 1))
cat("Confirmation that n=897 is minimum:\n")
cat(sprintf("  With n=%d: half-width = %.8f (≤ %.2f? %s)\n", 
            n_final - 1, achieved_hw_n_minus_1, half_width, 
            if(achieved_hw_n_minus_1 <= half_width) "YES" else "NO"))
cat(sprintf("  With n=%d: half-width = %.8f (≤ %.2f? %s)\n", 
            n_final, achieved_hw, half_width, 
            if(achieved_hw <= half_width) "YES" else "NO"))

# Verify the z-value
z_from_qnorm <- qnorm(0.975)
cat("\nZ-value verification:\n")
cat(sprintf("  Provided z (97.5th percentile): %.6f\n", z_critical))
cat(sprintf("  R qnorm(0.975): %.6f\n", z_from_qnorm))
cat(sprintf("  Difference: %.10f\n", abs(z_critical - z_from_qnorm)))

# Final result
library(jsonlite)
result <- list(
  results = list(
    list(metric = "sample_size", value = as.numeric(n_final), unit = "participants_total")
  )
)

cat("\nPOWER_AGENT_RESULT=")
cat(toJSON(result, auto_unbox = TRUE, digits = 15))

# Independent verification using alternative implementation
# Proportion confidence interval sample size calculation

# Specified parameters from the original request
p <- 0.70              # target proportion
conf_level <- 0.95     # confidence level (two-sided)
half_width <- 0.03     # desired half-width (margin of error)
z_critical <- 1.959964 # exact standard normal 97.5th percentile

# Manual calculation of sample size using the formula:
# n = z^2 * p(1-p) / ME^2

z_squared <- z_critical^2
p_times_q <- p * (1 - p)
me_squared <- half_width^2

n_continuous <- z_squared * p_times_q / me_squared

# Round upward
n_final <- ceiling(n_continuous)

cat("Independent Verification of Proportion Confidence Interval Sample Size\n")
cat("=====================================================================\n\n")
cat("Parameters:\n")
cat(sprintf("  Target proportion (p): %g\n", p))
cat(sprintf("  Confidence level: %g (two-sided)\n", conf_level))
cat(sprintf("  Desired half-width: %g\n", half_width))
cat(sprintf("  Standard normal 97.5th percentile: %g\n", z_critical))
cat("\nCalculation:\n")
cat(sprintf("  z² = (%.6f)² = %.10f\n", z_critical, z_squared))
cat(sprintf("  p(1-p) = %.2f × %.2f = %.2f\n", p, 1-p, p_times_q))
cat(sprintf("  ME² = (%.2f)² = %.4f\n", half_width, me_squared))
cat(sprintf("  n = %.10f × %.2f / %.4f = %.4f\n", z_squared, p_times_q, me_squared, n_continuous))
cat(sprintf("  n (rounded up) = %d\n\n", n_final))

# Verification: compute achieved half-width with n_final
achieved_se <- sqrt(p * (1 - p) / n_final)
achieved_hw <- z_critical * achieved_se

cat("Verification:\n")
cat(sprintf("  Standard error with n=%d: %.8f\n", n_final, achieved_se))
cat(sprintf("  Half-width achieved: z × SE = %.6f × %.8f = %.8f\n", 
            z_critical, achieved_se, achieved_hw))
cat(sprintf("  Target half-width: %.2f\n", half_width))
cat(sprintf("  Achieved ≤ Target? %s\n\n", if(achieved_hw <= half_width) "YES" else "NO"))

# Also check n-1 to confirm this is the minimum
achieved_hw_n_minus_1 <- z_critical * sqrt(p * (1 - p) / (n_final - 1))
cat("Confirmation that n=897 is minimum:\n")
cat(sprintf("  With n=%d: half-width = %.8f (≤ %.2f? %s)\n", 
            n_final - 1, achieved_hw_n_minus_1, half_width, 
            if(achieved_hw_n_minus_1 <= half_width) "YES" else "NO"))
cat(sprintf("  With n=%d: half-width = %.8f (≤ %.2f? %s)\n", 
            n_final, achieved_hw, half_width, 
            if(achieved_hw <= half_width) "YES" else "NO"))

# Verify the z-value
z_from_qnorm <- qnorm(0.975)
cat("\nZ-value verification:\n")
cat(sprintf("  Provided z (97.5th percentile): %.6f\n", z_critical))
cat(sprintf("  R qnorm(0.975): %.6f\n", z_from_qnorm))
cat(sprintf("  Difference: %.10f\n", abs(z_critical - z_from_qnorm)))

# Final result
library(jsonlite)
result <- list(
  results = list(
    list(metric = "sample_size", value = as.numeric(n_final), unit = "participants_total")
  )
)

cat("\nPOWER_AGENT_RESULT=")
cat(toJSON(result, auto_unbox = TRUE, digits = 15))
